description:
Publish an image or video story. Stories expire after 24 hours.

Supply exactly one of image_url or video_url. Stickers, polls, links and music cannot be added through the API — Meta exposes none of those on the publishing endpoint.

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a JPEG for an image story

video_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of an MP4/MOV for a video story

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for video processing before giving up and returning the container ID. 0 publishes immediately (images only). Default 60.

name: instagram_publish_story
title: Publish Story
